newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Newspaper editor shot dead in Ukraine.
newsitem.headline: Newspaper editor shot dead in Ukraine.

text.p: A Ukrainian newspaper editor was shot dead in the Black Sea port of Odessa in an apparent contract killing, regional prosecutor said on Monday.
Vasily Ivanov, chief regional prosecutor, told Reuters that Borys Derevyanko, editor-in-chief of the Vechernyaya Odessa daily, was killed on Monday morning near the newspaper's office.

"Derevyanko died instantly after being shot twice with a pistol on his way to work," Ivanov said. "We suppose that it is a contract killing because no shells were found at the site. There were no witnesses."
He gave no possible reasons for the attack and added that an official investigation had been launched.
Vechernyaya Odessa is the most influential newspaper in the city of one million and has the biggest circulation.
